claim_summary: HydroAgent introduces a hydrologic calibration benchmark and tool-mediated simulator episode, then trains Qwen3-4B with expert-trajectory SFT and simulator-feedback GRPO so parameter actions can improve iteratively.

claim_evidence.quote: Contributions. (1) The first systematic benchmark of nine frontier LLM agents on the calibration of an operational distributed hydrologic model, including a public release of all 9 × 20 trajectories for reproducibility (Section 3).
(H YDROAGENT) that fine-tunes Qwen3-4B with SFT + GRPO using NSE as a verifiable simulatorgrounded reward, with full training configuration sufficient to reproduce the run on 4×H100 (Section 2).

modules.name: Expert calibration trajectory corpus
modules.scope_reason: R2 LLM test: this trajectory corpus is built to train the Qwen3-4B model; it is model-side training data rather than an external runtime procedure.

evidence.quote: 2,576 SFT trajectories by distilling a strong proprietary teacher (GPT-51 ) on 73 calibration runs across 29 U.S. gauges (excluding the 4 gauges in the test set).

modules.name: Expert-trajectory supervised fine-tuning
modules.scope_reason: R2 LLM test: supervised fine-tuning updates Qwen3-4B parameters; a prompt-only or in-context procedure would be Harness, but this contribution changes the model itself.

evidence.quote: Phase 1: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on 2,576 expert calibration trajectories distills tool-call format and basic hydrologic reasoning into Qwen3-4B.

modules.name: Simulator-feedback GRPO policy optimization
modules.scope_reason: R2 LLM test: GRPO updates the Qwen3-4B policy parameters from simulator rewards; the surrounding rollout environment is a separate Harness module.

evidence.quote: We refer to our RL stage as Reinforcement Learning with Simulation Feedback (RLSF) to distinguish it from human-feedback RL (Lee et al., 2024)
is a numerical Earth-system simulator producing continuous physical-error metrics.

process_validity.quote: The diagnostic columns confirm that the gains travel with restored interaction: simulation counts return to 12–17 per episode, the full 50-turn budget is consumed on every gauge, and parse failures fall to zero across the panel.

task_performance.quote: Relative to the untuned base, the full SFT + RLSF stack lifts panel-mean NSE from −0.14 to +0.20 and panel-median NSE from +0.09 to +0.50, and converts a third basin from negative to positive NSE.

notes: Calibration is not one of the four closed task families, so it is recorded under other_tasks. The benchmark and trajectory corpus are separately reusable contributions. Evaluation is held out by gauge; the packet does not report a chronological split, leakage check, or information-cutoff test.
